key_insight: Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD) recovers exact ground-state energies for low-energy FeO and Fe₂O₂ model Hamiltonians using few quantum computational resources.
engineering_relevance: Combining ab initio-informed low-energy models with SQD offers a potential route toward simulating strongly correlated materials on existing quantum hardware.
method: Construct low-energy model Hamiltonians for molecular FeO and Fe₂O₂.
Compare classical exact diagonalization, Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE), and SQD.
Use SQD with two connectivity shells to recover ground-state energies.
evidence_signal: The study recovers FeO’s experimental quintet ground state and predicts a nonet for Fe₂O₂; SQD matches exact model ground energies, while raw VQE falls short of chemical accuracy.
watch_item: Results concern molecular model Hamiltonians, not a full bulk FeO calculation; scalability to larger solids remains to be established.
paper_title: Towards Quantum Computation of Bulk FeO
